name: Ma-Ho-Ro-Ba
source:
Main character is going to inherit a big trade business. His trial is to double 10 million yen in 13 months. Is it even possible to do with a shop, 10 million yen and while leading the same gigolo style life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公即将继承一项大型贸易生意。他的考验，是在13个月内让1000万日元翻倍。只有一家店、1000万日元，以及同样过着牛郎般生活的情况下，这真的可能做到吗？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
